boot_unreadable_body: We cannot read what this browser has stored: it belongs to a different version of the app. Nothing has been changed. You can start fresh — the old history will be deleted.
boot_unavailable_title: This browser is not keeping data
boot_unavailable_body: This browser will not let us store anything, so progress will not survive a reload. You can still practise now — this visit's results will be shown, but not saved.
product_h1: Learn to type without looking at the keyboard
product_lead: Typing-Race is a ten-finger typing trainer for Ukrainian and English. Each lesson opens new keys one step at a time, and after every attempt you see one concrete thing to do next.
product_stage1_body: You start on the home row. Eight kinds of scale — runs, mirror pairs, alternating hands, finger isolation, moves up and down, one finger across all its keys, modifiers and an even rhythm — train the movement of the fingers. A new key opens only after three accurate attempts in a row.
product_stage2_title: Words built only from unlocked letters
product_stage2_body: Next you type real words made only of keys you have already unlocked: not one letter your fingers do not know yet.
product_stage3_body: Your weakest transitions between letters, common n-grams, morphemes and work on tempo. The trainer picks out whatever you type most slowly.
product_p_blind_body: In test attempts the on-screen keyboard, the next-key highlight and the live readouts are not shown at all. Only time, errors and progress remain.
product_p_speed_body: An exercise is mastered after three accurate attempts in a row. Slow but clean counts in full.
product_p_errors_body: A wrong keystroke stays in the count even if you corrected it. Accuracy is the truth about how you typed, not about the final text.
product_p_next_body: After an attempt the trainer names exactly one thing to do next, not a list of tips.
product_open_title: Every number is open to audit
product_open_body: Every formula — speed, accuracy, rhythm, confidence and even the ambiguous spot in the requirements on transition difficulty — is published on a page of its own. You do not need to sign in to read it.
page_licences_body: Every Stage 1 exercise is generated from the finger map by the app itself, so no third-party dictionary is used here yet. Source Serif 4, Source Sans 3 and JetBrains Mono are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 and are served from our own origin — the app makes no request to any third party.
page_privacy_body: This app has no accounts, sends nothing to a server and uses no third-party analytics. Everything you type stays in your browser's storage and leaves with it. You can clear it at any time from Settings.
page_about_body: Typing-Race is a touch-typing trainer for Ukrainian and English. A three-stage curriculum leads from keyboard scales to words built only from the keys you have unlocked, and on to an Academy of rhythm and n-grams. Speed never gates progress: accuracy does.
narrow_window_notice: Typing-Race is built for a computer with a physical keyboard, from 1024 pixels wide. Touch typing cannot be learned on an on-screen keyboard, so we show this instead of a broken typing line. Open the app on a laptop or desktop — or simply widen this window.
